body: Raised by wf-hatchet. WaitSpec.Key is fixed on the Workflow definition, so two concurrent runs cannot wait on different keys (an order ID per run). Candidate: WaitSpec.KeyFrom ConcurrencyKey (Go func over the Job, or an engine expression such as Hatchet CEL). Hatchet's DAG wait condition is static too; check whether its event condition expression can reference run input before claiming it.
title: Decide per-run wait keys: WaitSpec.Key is static per workflow
